headline: Hemmings Alone Against Suzuki And Gray
deck: Spurs v Villa Saturday: test4 trail 123 0-11, with Suzuki and Gray facing George Hemmings across the fixture.
body:
Saturday's early game is where test4 finally has something to swing. Trailing 123 nought to eleven, the tie has been one-way traffic, but Suzuki and Gray sit on one side of this fixture and George Hemmings on the other. Ninety minutes with the right men active and the deficit stops looking terminal.

Elsewhere the fixture matters without a duel to settle. test3331 have Barkley in the middle of it, test31 lean on Buendía, and both watch the same pitch for entirely different reasons. Nobody here needs telling what a 12:30 haul does to a weekend.
